transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because of some issues at work. People keep telling me they can't follow what I'm trying to explain. 

Like... my artist statements, or notes for clients. Even just when I talk in meetings. They say I keep jumping around from... I don't know, things like textures, to the budgets, to... secret meanings. I'm just... they just say they don't understand me right now.
Do you believe that other people are sending you secret messages?

I mean... I don't know about "secret messages," exactly. It's just... sometimes things seem really obvious to me. 

Like, I'll see a certain stain on a canvas, or the way a seam is stitched, or... or even just a specific phrase in an email from a gallery. And I just know it's... it's about me. Like it's a warning, or instructions for what I'm supposed to do next with my art. People try to tell me it's just a coincidence, or just a normal email, but... it's really hard to just ignore it when it feels that clear.
Have you been hearing voices that other people don’t hear?

Um... sometimes. Mostly just when I'm alone in the studio. 

I'll... I guess I hear a woman, sometimes. Just quietly commenting from behind the shelves. And... sometimes I'll smell things, too. Like hot metal near an unfinished piece. It all feels completely real when it happens, but... when I go over to check, there's nothing there. So... yeah.
Have these experiences been going on continuously for at least six months?
Um... yeah. I guess so. The... the things with the emails and the materials, and... hearing her in the studio... it's been happening for a while. Maybe... roughly 11 months, I think.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt very depressed or lost interest in things, while also having these psychotic symptoms?
Um... I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really been tracking it like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt unusually energized or overly happy, with much less need for sleep?

Um... yeah, I suppose. There are stretches where I just feel... I don't know, lit up. Like I'm almost unstoppable, and every idea I have for a piece is just... brilliant. 

But... I guess it's not always just a good feeling. Sometimes, if someone I'm working with makes even a small comment, I might... snap. Just... react in a way that feels a lot bigger than the situation actually is. So... yeah.
During those times you felt 'lit up' and almost unstoppable, did you also need much less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess. When I'm working late like that, I don't really need much. I might sleep for... maybe two or three hours. And then I just wake up feeling bright, you know? Ready to keep going. I don't feel tired like I usually would.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was so elevated or irritable that other people thought you were acting unusually or out of character?

Um... I don't know what other people think. But... when I'm really charged up like that, I just feel... different. Like I'm about to change how everyone understands installation art. It just feels like normal limits... you know, funding, time, even my own experience... they just don't apply to me then. I don't know if that looks unusual to anyone else, though.
Have there been times when you were hearing or seeing things or महसूसing suspicious ideas even though you were not in one of those unusually energized or irritable periods?

Um... yeah. There was... a month, maybe? I wasn't feeling like that. I was sleeping fine, not... not charged up. But... I still heard things. Like... whispers, or comments coming from behind the shelves in the studio. And... I don't know, I just felt like there were warnings in the materials I was using. Just ordinary things, but... it felt like they meant something else. That went on for a few weeks, I think.
Have you ever had at least two weeks when you had hallucinations or unusual beliefs even though you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Um... yeah. Like I just said... it was about a month where things were quieter. I was sleeping normally, not feeling... unstoppable or anything like that. But for several weeks during that time, I was still hearing those comments from behind the shelves. And seeing those warnings in my materials. So... yes.
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing or believing these things while your mood was completely normal, with no manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Um... yeah. I mean, like I just said... there was that quieter month. I was sleeping normally, and I wasn't feeling unstoppable or anything. My mood was just... normal, I guess. But for a few weeks during that time, I was still hearing those comments from behind the shelves... and seeing those hidden warnings in my materials. So... yeah.
Have you ever had at least two weeks when you were hearing things or believing unusual things while your mood was completely normal, with no manic or depressed symptoms at all?

I... I thought we just went over this. Yes. There was that month where... things were quiet. My mood was fine. I was sleeping. But I still heard the voices... for weeks. And the warnings. I don't know what else to say about it.
Have your voices or unusual beliefs ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

Yes... I feel like I keep answering this. 

Even when I wasn't feeling unstoppable... when things were quiet and I was sleeping normally... I still heard the comments from behind the shelves. And I still saw those hidden warnings in my studio materials. That went on for several weeks. I don't... I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Have there ever been times when your hallucinations or unusual beliefs continued even while you were clearly feeling depressed or manic?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Like... when I get really charged up with my work, when I'm barely sleeping and taking on way too much. During those times, I still... I was still sure that the stains and the phrases in my emails were giving me instructions. And... I'd still hear that woman commenting in the studio sometimes. So, yes.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you had hallucinations or unusual beliefs but were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

I... I really don't understand why we're going in circles. I just answered this. 

Like I told you, yes. There was a quieter month. I was sleeping normally, not feeling unstoppable. But I still heard the comments from behind the shelves... and saw the hidden warnings in my studio materials. That went on for a few weeks. I don't have a different answer for you.
Have there ever been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or believing these things while you were clearly depressed?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt depressed. Just... the other things.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
No... I just said that. I haven't... I haven't really been depressed. Not like that.
Have your hallucinations or unusual beliefs ever lasted for at least two weeks when you were not having any mood episode at all?

I... I don't understand. You just asked me this a minute ago. 

Yes. Like I said... there was a quieter month. I was sleeping normally. I didn't feel unstoppable. But I still heard the comments from behind the shelves, and... saw the warnings in my studio materials. For several weeks. I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Have there been long stretches when the voices or unusual beliefs were present without any manic or depressive symptoms at all?

I... I just told you this. Yes. There was a month where things were... quieter. I was sleeping. I wasn't feeling like I could do everything at once. But the comments... from the shelves... they were still there. And the materials in my studio still had those warnings. That went on for a few weeks. I don't... I don't have anything else to add to that.
Have you had mood symptoms, like mania or depression, for most of the time that these voices and unusual beliefs have been happening?

I guess so. If I look back over the year... the stretches where I'm really energized, or... irritable and working non-stop... they take up more time than the calmer parts. It goes up and down, but... yeah. Mostly it's been like that.
